final_message:
I've written the September 2026 draft for Bluebird Bakery Co and saved both files in `evals/runs/clean-run-20261012/g_bb_no_ttm/skill_output/`:
- **Report:** `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md`, with my 8 commentary bullets in section 1 and the DRAFT banner kept.
- **Data:** `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json`, which every figure comes from.

**Data quality: one mismatch.** In Mar 2026, 'Total for Professional Services' states 2,225.00, but its detail rows add up to 2,200.00 (25.00 apart). The analysis uses the detail rows; the reviewer needs to decide which figure is right. Gross profit, net income and the balance sheet all match the workbook's own totals. Two parts of the sheet's layout had to be filled in, and the reviewer should check them:
- 'Total Delivery' had no header row, so its two accounts were grouped from the rows above it.
- 'Charitable Donations' has no values and no total row, so it's counted as zero.

The export only covers Jan–Sep 2026, so there are no year-on-year or trailing-twelve-month figures.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue was 81,300**, up 17.7% on August (69,050) and up 17.3% on the prior 6-month average (69,292). Most of the increase is a new Wholesale Accounts stream, at 12,000 after zero in the prior six months. Pastry Sales have fallen about 2% in every month shown (Apr–Sep).
- **Gross margin was 65.3%**, up 5.7 points on August and the highest month of the period.
- **Wages & Salaries rose from 16,000 to 21,000**, after staying at 16,000 from January to August. That puts Payroll & Benefits up 28.4% and total operating expenses up 21.0% to 31,570. One month can't show whether it's a new level, so the reviewer needs to confirm.
- **Cash fell to 37,600**, down 1,800 on August and down 10,800 on six months earlier, even though every month made a profit. Equity also fell, from 54,660 to 44,940. I left this as a question for the reviewer, since the export doesn't show why.

**Accounts in "Other":** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates match no category rule. Mystery Shopper Program shows "from 0" against August, but it was 400 in March, June and September. I described it as recurring roughly quarterly, not as a new expense.
